title: Hang Gliding Tahoe
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: You’re dressed in a chic flight suit and boots. Just so you know, even Winter flying can be spectacular with snow in the mountains and a completely new view of Lake Tahoe. We keep you toasty warm with the latest technology in heated clothing, boots and gloves. Visit our page Winter Flying to learn more.

quotes.author: Erica - Incline Village
quotes.text: It was a little scary at first but as soon as we climbed up to see Tahoe and Incline Village I relaxed and flew it myself. It provided me a completely new perspective of Tahoe and what I thought was a scary experience of triking. Now I know where to send people if they want the ultimate Tahoe adventure.

quotes.author: Saleema - Group Leader
quotes.text: Was a little apprehensive before I started. Paul is an awesome person to ease your nerves and get me going flying the wing. Up there in the sky it was one of the best times and an experience I will NEVER forget!! Thanks allot Paul.

Great way to experience flight and see the beautiful mountains and Lake Tahoe. – Richard What a delightful experience. Paul is incredibly experienced and capable and i felt safe, yet adventurous all at once. Awesome. – Melanie

quotes.author: Chuck - Princess Anne
quotes.text: This was an experience of a lifetime. You really are the best. Thanks so much for making this the most memorable trip of a lifetime. After we flew in the airplane and trike I am leaning towards the trike since it is so open.

quotes.author: Quinn - Reno
quotes.text: That is an awesome new trike. The wing is so clean compared to what I am used to flying. The extra speed, glass panel and comfort is a big upgrade. Wish I could get into the air more often. It felt great to be flying again.

quotes.author: Janie - Incline Village
quotes.text: This is the most exciting activity in Tahoe. I had no idea it was so fun and easy to fly. This is spectacular and you get to fly it as much as you want. It is nice to have this unique experience available for our customers.
